transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… I guess I’m here because things at work have gotten a little hard to sort out. I do environmental modeling, contract work, and I’ve been noticing revisions I make being tracked in ways that don’t feel accidental.

I know this may sound… I don’t know, maybe I’m not explaining it right. But I’m pretty sure some people on the contract are planting errors in the datasets so it looks like I’m not capable of leading the work. My wife and a couple of junior analysts keep saying it’s probably just version-control mistakes, and I understand why they’d say that, but it doesn’t feel like that to me.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?

I don’t think so, no. I mean, I’ll sometimes sort of replay conversations in my head, especially when I’m stressed, but not like… a voice in the room when no one’s there. If that’s what you mean, then no, I haven’t noticed that.
How long have you been convinced that people at work are deliberately planting errors to undermine you?

Um… I’d say it’s been maybe around two months that I’ve felt pretty sure about it. I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is, but the feeling that my revisions are being tracked and that errors are being put in on purpose has been there for about that long.
Before this started, had you had any recent head injury, seizure, or other neurological illness?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, nothing like a head injury or a seizure that I’m aware of. I haven’t had anything neurological going on, at least not that anyone’s told me. Is that… is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do you still believe people at work are deliberately planting errors even when others show you reasons it could be a normal version-control mistake?

I mean… I try to listen when they say that. I don’t want to be unreasonable. But yes, I still have a hard time accepting it’s just version-control mistakes. It’s happened in a way that feels too specific, like my revisions are being watched and then errors show up where it makes me look like I can’t lead the contract. My wife says I may be reading too much into it, and some of the junior analysts have said the same, but… I still think someone there is doing it on purpose.
Have you had the sense that someone can put thoughts into your mind that are not your own?

No… I don’t think it’s like someone putting thoughts into my mind. It’s more that I’m pretty sure people on that environmental modeling contract have been tracking my revisions and putting errors into the datasets to make me look like I can’t lead the work. I know my wife and some of the junior analysts say it could just be version-control mistakes, and I’m trying to hear that, but it still feels deliberate to me.
Have you noticed yourself becoming much less emotionally expressive than usual?

Maybe a little, yes. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but… I do sit for hours sometimes, at my desk or out in the garage, and the telescope’s still covered. I used to be more eager to go hiking or help the younger analysts, or go to those astronomy nights.

Lately I just don’t feel much pull to start things or talk to people. I’m not trying to be difficult or anything… it’s just harder to get that feeling going. Is that what you mean?
Have people told you lately that your speech is hard to follow or seems to jump from one idea to another?

Not really, no. I mean, I can get a little long-winded when I’m trying to explain something technical, but I don’t think people have said I’m hard to follow or jumping around.

If I was doing that, I’d want to know. But no, I haven’t noticed anyone telling me that lately.
Aside from this situation at work, have you been able to manage your usual day-to-day life about as well as before?

I’d like to say yes… and I’m still getting by in some ways. But, honestly, not as well as before.

At work I’ve fallen behind enough on the modeling deliverables that they’ve reassigned parts of the contract, which is… embarrassing. And I’m supposed to be helping the junior analysts, supervising them, but I don’t think I’ve been very useful lately.

At home, I mostly keep to myself. My wife has had to nudge me just to keep up with basic routines. I’m trying, though. I don’t want it to sound like I’ve completely fallen apart.
For at least one month, have you had this drop in motivation and pulling away from people nearly every day?

Yes… I think so. I don’t like putting it that strongly, but it has been pretty much most days.

I can sit for hours at my desk, or out in the garage, and the telescope’s still covered. And I know I used to enjoy hiking, helping the younger analysts, going to astronomy nights… it’s not that I’ve decided I don’t care. I just don’t feel much pull to start anything or to talk to people.

That’s been going on for a while now, yes.
From when these changes first began, has it been six months or longer?

Yes… I think it has been longer than six months.

It’s hard to admit, but if I’m being honest, this whole slide really started after I was put in charge of that larger environmental modeling contract. That was about two years and… two months ago, I think.

I kept telling myself it was just the pressure of the project, and maybe some of it was, but the changes go back that far.
Outside of the situation at work, have you been convinced that anyone is trying to harm, monitor, or control you?

I mean… outside of work, not really in a broad sense. I don’t think the neighbors or strangers are after me, if that’s what you mean.

But with that contract… yes, I’ve been pretty sure the people involved have been watching my revisions more closely than they admit. And I know this may sound like I’m making excuses, but it feels like errors are showing up in the datasets in a way that makes me look like I can’t lead the work.

My wife says it’s probably version-control mistakes, and the junior analysts have said similar things. I hear that. I do. But it’s hard for me to shake the feeling that it’s being done on purpose.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast so that other people could know them?

No… not broadcast, exactly. I don’t think people can hear my thoughts or anything like that.

It’s more that, with that environmental modeling contract, I’ve felt pretty sure people were tracking my revisions and… maybe putting errors into the datasets so it would look like I couldn’t lead it. I know my wife and some of the junior analysts say it’s probably just version-control problems, and maybe that’s the more reasonable way to look at it. But it’s been hard for me to accept that.
During this time, have you had a period where you felt distinctly depressed most of the day nearly every day?

I’m not sure I’d call it distinctly depressed, no. I mean, I’ve had rough stretches and I haven’t exactly been cheerful about all of this, but… most of the day nearly every day? I don’t think so.

At least, not in the way you’re probably asking. Does that answer it okay?
